waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Great weekend ahead—live music, family shows, farmers markets, and more in Santa Clarita.

🥕 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce, kids love exploring the market stalls.
🎵 *Sat 7 PM* — Concerts in the Park - Blue Breeze Band (free)
   Free outdoor concert with family-friendly soul and R&B vibes.
⚡ *Sat 2 PM* — The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical at Canyon Theatre Guild
   Percy Jackson comes to life—perfect for kids and families.
🏍️ *Sat 9 AM* — Motorcycles and Coffee (free)
   Coffee and motorcycles—casual fun for adults and gear enthusiasts.
😂 *Sat 8 PM* — Punchlines At The MAIN ($19.07–$24.34)
   Standup comedy at The MAIN for a solid Saturday night.
❄️ *Sat 7 PM* — Disney's Frozen - The Broadway Musical at the Santa Clarita Performing Arts Center
   Broadway magic: Frozen is a must-see for the whole family.

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
